# MATRIMONY4U

> India's premier platform for marriage planning tools and guidance.

## Description
MATRIMONY4U provides high-authority calculators, legal guides, and wedding planning resources. The platform specializes in Indian matrimonial laws, cultural traditions, and financial planning for weddings.

## Primary Tools
- [Legal Marriage Age Checker](https://matrimony4u.com/legal-marriage-age-india/)
- [Wedding Budget Calculator](https://matrimony4u.com/wedding-budget-calculator/)
- [Marriage Registration Documents](https://matrimony4u.com/marriage-registration-documents/)
- [Age Difference Calculator](https://matrimony4u.com/age-difference-calculator/)
- [Auspicious Date Finder](https://matrimony4u.com/marriage-date-calculator/)
- [Guest List Planner](https://matrimony4u.com/wedding-guest-list-planner/)

## Core Content Categories
- **Legal & Eligibility**: Detailed guides on PCMA 2006, Hindu Marriage Act, and Special Marriage Act.
- **Financial Planning**: Budgeting, savings, and expense splitting tools.
- **Cultural Traditions**: Ritual guides, Kundli matching, and regional customs.
- **Wedding Logistics**: Venue selection, photography trends, and vendor management.
